## Checklist

- [ ] The folder holds exactly the six canon files, and its name matches `manifest.id`
- [ ] `tastepilot canon validate ./canons/<id>` passes locally
- [ ] I rendered a long, real document with it and read the result — on a narrow viewport and on paper
- [ ] The dark palette is its own design, not an inversion of the light one
- [ ] The `fallbacks` stack holds the design when no webfont loads
- [ ] Every font named is one anyone may use
- [ ] I have the right to license this under the repository's MIT license
